name: Koi × Koi = ∞ ~Koisuru Otome ni Dekiru Koto~
original_name: 恋×恋=∞　～恋する乙女にできること～
source:
Fuuma is part of the ‘love support committee’, founded by the school’s most popular idol Naho, along with his senpai Ayane and imouto Nagisa, to give those boys and girls in love a little stiff push. Overcoming many obstacles, their ultimate goal is to revive the legend of love in the school and to know the importance of true love.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
